reference_regions: Current pixel-lab rectangles are rescaled from the manually selected photo-bank regions and used only for final result checking. Inspection patch positions are explicit display guides and do not enter inference. No learning is performed for the active 4x4 exercise.
challenge_crops: The active exercise explicitly displays averaged face crops: Collins 24x21, Hopper 24x15 and cat 28x15. Search covers every complete 4x4 patch of the displayed crop, with no additional eye-location mask.

single_filter_derivative.method: Same-photo normalized-patch LinearSVC with hard-negative mining; one quantized 17x13 coefficient array per portrait. Coffee reuses Collins. No browser training. Exact deterministic grayscale pixels included.
single_filter_derivative.evaluation_scope: Prepared-photo classroom fixtures, not held-out or unseen-image detector accuracy.
single_filter_derivative.status: Preserved inactive 17x13 development artifact; not loaded by the current participant page.

pixel_filter_derivative.method: Pillow grayscale crop and BOX averaging; explicit hand-designed 4x4 -1/+1 kernels, no fitting.
pixel_filter_derivative.inspection_guides: Provided display patch centers, independent of full-crop inference.
pixel_filter_derivative.evaluation_scope: Constrained same-view classroom pattern exercise, not general eye detection accuracy.
